title: TokenDelivery.ai — Tokens, delivered.
excerpt: Open-weight models, fully deterministic. The same answer every time, byte for byte, at the floor price.
content_html:
Tokens,

delivered.

Open-weight models, fully deterministic. The same answer every time, byte for byte. Free while we're in preview.

Getting started

01. Create an account

Sign up in a dialog, make a key in API Keys. It's free while we're in preview: no card.

02. Call the API

OpenAI-compatible: point any client at the base URL with your key.

03. Or try it here

The playground streams answers, takes pictures and short videos, and exposes every sampling parameter. Questions: the Contact window.
